turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: What made you choose 12Labs over building TTS in-house?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Cost and speed. Building an in-house model would've taken our team six months minimum. We had a working coach-voice feature in production in two weeks.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Anything that's made you reconsider that choice since?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Not reconsider, but we're watching the pricing closely as our user base grows — at some point in-house might become cheaper, though quality would probably drop.
